These instructions use the CL format.

C.LW loads a 32-bit value from memory into register _`rd′`_ . It computes an effective address by adding the _zero_ -extended offset, scaled by 4, to the base address in register _`rs1′`_ . It expands to `lw rd′, offset(rs1′)` .

C.LD is an RV64C-only instruction that loads a 64-bit value from memory into register _`rd′`_ . It computes an effective address by adding the _zero_ -extended offset, scaled by 8, to the base address in register

_`rs1′`_ . It expands to `ld rd′, offset(rs1′)` .

C.FLW is an RV32FC-only instruction that loads a single-precision floating-point value from memory into floating-point register _`rd′`_ . It computes an effective address by adding the _zero_ -extended offset, scaled by 4, to the base address in register _`rs1′`_ . It expands to `flw rd′, offset(rs1′)` .

C.FLD is an RV32DC/RV64DC-only instruction that loads a double-precision floating-point value from memory into floating-point register _`rd′`_ . It computes an effective address by adding the _zero_ -extended offset, scaled by 8, to the base address in register _`rs1′`_ . It expands to `fld rd′, offset(rs1′)` .
